principle: Research destinations where a truthful current window is valuable to visitors. Existing/available travel programs help identify useful next-step categories, but may not lower source-quality or truth standards.

columns.visitorDecisionValue: How much seeing the place now could change timing/expectations
columns.sourcePriority: Research priority based on quality gap + visitor usefulness, not commission
columns.programFamilies: Program categories that may support the destination type; exact partner/destination coverage still requires verification

rows.why: Five source-specific Kyoto tourism cameras are published. Nishiki Market is schedule-aware (11:00–18:00 JST), while the other approved sources provide broader current-condition coverage.
rows.next: Maintain the five approved sources, preserving Nishiki's published live hours. Expand only when a distinct visitor decision is served and exact source proof is available.

rows.why: Two truthful official external live windows exist; inside-ERN playback is not necessary for usefulness.
rows.next: Recheck unavailable official-tourism webcams only on material provider change.

rows.why: Official 24-hour Seoul Plaza live cam now fills the first visual gap, while separate official real-time crowd/traffic/weather context remains available for future Guide integration.
rows.next: Maintain Seoul Plaza; research additional distinct visitor-area visuals only if they add utility beyond the plaza/context layer.

rows.why: A current Sukhumvit Road live view now gives ERN a useful Bangkok street-condition window without relying on the reduced-stability BMA traffic application.
rows.next: Maintain Sukhumvit; seek a second distinct river/landmark/current-condition view only if quality is clearly stronger and non-duplicative.

rows.why: Official Chiang Mai PAO Smart City CCTV was rechecked again on 2026-09-29. The portal is active and labels the center real-time, but all four public cameras still show STANDBY / WAITING FOR FEED.
rows.next: Keep the PAO lane on material-change watch only. Prioritize future For Places outreach to farms, resorts, markets and attractions rather than treating standby camera inventory as live coverage.

rows.why: A municipal live park window directly answers whether a seasonal trip is worth making now.
rows.next: Keep one selective live window; do not import the full municipal camera network without distinct visitor need.

rows.why: Chidori remains intentionally off-season. A fresh 2026-09-29 review of official Tokyo tourism/government surfaces did not identify a rights-clear year-round central-Tokyo live visual suitable for ERN; Tokyo Port remains the best official research lane.
rows.next: Keep Chidori deferred until Sakura season or material provider change. Continue Tokyo Port / official-government camera research and add a central Tokyo source only when exact currentness and rights are clear.

rows.destination: New York City / Statue of Liberty
rows.why: Multiple strong current skyline/harbour/Statue of Liberty windows already cover New York City visitor interest; avoid unrelated New York State sources in this destination row.
rows.next: Maintain quality and destination coherence; new sources need a clearly different New York City visitor use.

rows.why: Strong inside-ERN harbour view plus useful destination-specific planning actions already prove the model.
rows.next: Maintain reliability rather than adding density.

rows.why: Sydney.com was rechecked on 2026-09-29 and strongly covers Sydney Harbour visitor planning, but no official tourism/government live visual with a clear ERN reuse/embed path was identified. Coogee remains the truthful current visual.
rows.next: Maintain Coogee. Continue looking for a rights-clear official Sydney Harbour current window; do not promote generic harbour imagery or an unverified third-party feed as live.

rows.why: Two direct official/current beach-condition paths now cover Waikīkī: Hilton's beach/city webcam and Waikīkī Aquarium's South Shore webcam.
rows.next: Maintain the two distinct official/current views; add only if a surf/weather/city condition source offers materially different utility.

rows.why: Official Eiffel Tower pages were rechecked on 2026-09-29 and expose current opening status, attendance, temperature, wind and summit/visit conditions. ERN still lacks a rights-clear current visual window for Paris itself, so this remains context-only evidence rather than a camera source.
rows.next: Preserve Eiffel live visitor context as non-visual evidence only. Continue searching for a rights-clear current Paris visual source; do not convert visitor telemetry into a LIVE camera claim.

rows.why: A current Spanish Steps live view now gives ERN a strong visitor-activity window for central Rome.
rows.next: Maintain the Spanish Steps view; add another Rome source only if it provides clearly different utility such as Colosseum or Trevi conditions and remains current.

rows.why: A current port/skyline live view now fills the first Singapore visual gap; Marina Bay-specific provider pages are currently offline and remain excluded.
rows.next: Maintain current port view; recheck Marina Bay/downtown sources only on material provider change.

rows.why: Official current Arctic Circle village view strongly supports seasonal/weather/atmosphere decisions before a Lapland trip.
rows.next: Maintain one strong live village window; add another Finland source only when it offers a distinct visitor decision.

rows.why: NPS live stream directly shows geyser-basin conditions and happenings; ERN already has broader Yellowstone coverage.

rows.next: Reverify real public individual-camera playback before promoting the source. Portal reachability or inventory count alone is insufficient.
